import asyncio

async def act(page):
    # Click the Edit link for Frankie Sweatshirt to navigate to the product edit page
    edit_link = page.get_by_role("row", name="Frankie Sweatshirt").get_by_role("link", name="Edit Frankie Sweatshirt")
    await edit_link.click()
    # Wait for the page to load after navigation
    await asyncio.sleep(5)
    return "Navigated to Frankie Sweatshirt edit page"
